title: Sheafification of an explicit finite free resolution on an affine chart
statement: Let X be a scheme, U an open, and e : U.toScheme ≅ Spec A [def-weil-affine-spectrum]. Let M be an A-module, and let an explicit augmented exact resolution of M by finite free A-modules be given by ranks n, augmentation ε and maps d, with surjectivity and kernel-range equalities. Then there is a bounded-above cochain complex [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology] of finite free sheaves of modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] on the over-site of U and a quasi-isomorphism to the degree-zero complex of the transported tilde of M [lem-weil-pbc-spec-module-tilde-sections]. The construction places the j-th free term in degree -j, applies tilde, and transports along e and the open-subscheme/over-site equivalence.

source.place: Lemma 26.5.4, Tag 01HV, functoriality and exactness of tilde; Modules Lemma 17.3.1, Tag 01AG; Algebra Lemma 10.71.1, Tag 00LP supplies the algebraic resolution used by the parent

proof.text: Define the cochain complex from the augmented exact resolution by placing the j-th free module in degree -j and zero above degree zero; kernel-range identities give d squared zero and the augmentation.
Apply tilde termwise; localization of tilde stalks and module stalk exactness imply the augmented sheaf complex is quasi-isomorphic to the degree-zero tilde module.
Transport the complex and augmentation across the affine chart and over-site equivalences; finite functions give finite free sheaf terms, including rank zero above the bound.

proof_origin.place: Tag 01HV, functorial exactness of tilde, applied to the resolution of Tag 00LP, with stalk detection from Tag 01AG
